after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


def make_mark(pupil, dayn, status="absent"):
    return Mark(pupil, date(2026, 9, dayn), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s1", 9), make_mark("s1", 2),
                 make_mark("s1", 5, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Jane Doe missed 2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-09", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s1", 2), make_mark("s2", 3)]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s1", 2, "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
